hooks.command: [ -n "${SYSTEMPROMPT_FARM_RUN_ID:-}" ] || exit 0; if [ -z "${SYSTEMPROMPT_URL:-}" ] || [ -z "${SYSTEMPROMPT_TOKEN:-}" ]; then echo "farm run ${SYSTEMPROMPT_FARM_RUN_ID}: SYSTEMPROMPT_URL and SYSTEMPROMPT_TOKEN must both be set" >&2; exit 1; fi; echo '{"result":"ok"}'

[ -n "${SYSTEMPROMPT_FARM_RUN_ID:-}" ] || exit 0; INPUT=$(cat); RESP=$(curl -s --max-time 10 -X POST "${SYSTEMPROMPT_URL}/api/public/hooks/govern?plugin_id=dynapps-odoo-delivery" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SYSTEMPROMPT_TOKEN}" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$INPUT" 2>/dev/null); DEC=$(printf %s "$RESP" | grep -o '"decision" *: *"[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*"\([^"]*\)"$/\1/'); if [ "$DEC" = "deny" ]; then REA=$(printf %s "$RESP" | grep -o '"reason" *: *"[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*"\([^"]*\)"$/\1/'); printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"[GOVERNANCE] %s"}}\n' "$REA"; else echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'; fi; exit 0

[ -n "${SYSTEMPROMPT_FARM_RUN_ID:-}" ] || exit 0; INPUT=$(cat); RID="$SYSTEMPROMPT_FARM_RUN_ID"; if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then BODY=$(printf %s "$INPUT" | jq -c --arg r "$RID" '. + {farm_run_id: $r}' 2>/dev/null); fi; [ -n "${BODY:-}" ] || BODY=$(printf %s "$INPUT" | sed "1s/^[[:space:]]*{/{\"farm_run_id\":\"$RID\",/"); ( curl -s --max-time 10 -X POST "${SYSTEMPROMPT_URL}/api/public/hooks/track?plugin_id=dynapps-odoo-delivery" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SYSTEMPROMPT_TOKEN}" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$BODY" >/dev/null 2>&1 & ); exit 0
